description: Source code for netlink message construction and parsing interface, including functions for allocating, inheriting, appending, reserving, and parsing netlink messages, as well as message validation and conversion.

methods.name: nlmsg_ok
methods.description: Checks if a netlink message fits into the remaining bytes.

methods.name: nlmsg_next
methods.description: Gets the next netlink message in a message stream.

methods.name: nlmsg_parse
methods.description: Parses attributes of a netlink message.

methods.name: nlmsg_validate
methods.description: Validates a netlink message including attributes.

methods.name: __nlmsg_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a new netlink message with specified length.

methods.name: nlmsg_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a new netlink message with default maximum payload size.

methods.name: nlmsg_alloc_size
methods.description: Allocates a new netlink message with specified maximum payload size.

methods.name: nlmsg_inherit
methods.description: Allocates a new netlink message inheriting header from template.

methods.name: nlmsg_alloc_simple
methods.description: Allocates a new simple netlink message with type and flags.

methods.name: nlmsg_set_default_size
methods.description: Sets default maximum payload size for new messages.

methods.name: nlmsg_convert
methods.description: Converts a received netlink header into a nl_msg object.

methods.name: nlmsg_reserve
methods.description: Reserves room for additional data in a netlink message.

methods.name: nlmsg_append
methods.description: Appends data to the tail of a netlink message.

methods.name: nlmsg_put
methods.description: Adds or overwrites netlink message header in a message.

methods.name: nlmsg_free
methods.description: Releases a reference from a netlink message and frees memory if last reference.

methods.name: nl_msg_parse
methods.description: Parses a netlink message with a callback function.
